title: Kagamine Rin — Leave It To Us!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Rin, Len, thanks for practicing with us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
Singing with you guys was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, about that video of your third event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, don't give me that!
Rin and I have been waiting fooorever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah! How much longer is it gonna take?
We can't wait after hearing from you guys how amazing it was!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: When do we get to see it?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, we have some good news regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The person we asked to help us just let us know that they've finished editing it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be checking the footage on behalf of Vivid BAD SQUAD, so if there are no issues—

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes! Finally! We get to see it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, relax... We're getting it back today, so you guys won't get to see it until tomorrow at the earliest.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's totally fine!
Oh, we'll ask MEIKO to see if we can watch it there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta get things ready so that we can all watch!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Agreed! So, later, you guys!
We'll see you all tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They left without letting me say that we're supposed to meet with Taiga tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We won't see him until later in the day, so we can just come here in the morning, put on the video and chill, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, you there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin, Len, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you two run over here? What's the hurry?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Guess what?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? We finally get to see the video of their third event?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? You don't sound all that excited.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, Kohane and the others already told us about what happened and how things went.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, neither MEIKO nor I will be here tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Whaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Don't you remember what I said? We promised to have singing practice with Luka, so the cafe's going to be closed tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
N-Now I remember...
But... Just when I thought we'd finally get to see what their third event was really like...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, can't you guys hold off on singing until later?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As much as we'd like to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'd be making her wait endlessly all by herself if we don't go.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right... Then, I guess there's nothing we can do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you can still watch it here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please feel free to eat or make whatever you like. There should be plenty of snacks and drinks to go around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But promise me that neither of you will try to use the stove by yourselves. And be sure to clean up afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we promise!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That just leaves how to set everything up for watching videos. Come with me, you two.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, that's it!
Everything's set up for tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't forget to come watch if singing practice with Luka ends early or something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, we will.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me neither!
